learn_source: Watch the postman close the festival letters in the Square before the rounds — a letter that opens in the rain is a letter lost
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on a folded letter once
mana_effect: Quality only: at high mana the seal is weather-tight and opens clean for the receiver; at baseline it holds but tears a little coming off. Never whether the cast is possible.

receivers.physical_outcome: Seals shut along the fold, weather-tight
no_effect — it is already closed; the cast finds nothing open
State-dependent: dry wrapping seals tight at every seam; soaked wrapping will not take the seal until it dries
The lid seats and seals — pantry-tight
No physical effect — nothing on a living body closes

receivers.reaction_kind: quiet withdrawal a step back from the caster
